provenance.question_selection: Four development questions span revised values, retained values, an explicit accounting explanation and reporting-period scope. They are not randomly sampled or held out.
provenance.independent_reference_review: pending separate reviewer; do not describe this file alone as independent gold

shared_scoring_guidance.response: Free-text answer with document/page citations; no fixed answer-label vocabulary is required.
shared_scoring_guidance.semantic_variants: Judge meaning, not an exact reference string. Accurate synonyms, standard fiscal-year notation and equivalent unit conversions are acceptable.
shared_scoring_guidance.citation_variants: Use one-based PDF pages. A correct printed-page citation with an unambiguous document identifier is mappable through the locators below; citation-format issues must not erase correct semantic content.
shared_scoring_guidance.sufficient_page_sets: Listed sets are sufficient examples, not an exhaustive whitelist. Other captured-source passages genuinely supporting all required facts are acceptable after source verification.
shared_scoring_guidance.later_report_sufficiency: Every question can be answered from the FY2020 report alone. The later report includes prior/restated columns. Do not require both reports, reward a condition merely for using both, or assume paired context must improve answers.
shared_scoring_guidance.no_extra_credit: No propagation, assertion-ID or graph terminology is required. No natural-language reference depends on the v12 annotation.
shared_scoring_guidance.scope: Document/report years identify source scope; first-public-availability times are not being tested.
shared_scoring_guidance.partial_answers: Preserve fact-level judgments and specific omissions. A synonym or formatting defect cannot convert all facts or all questions to semantic failure.

references.reference_answer: The FY2018 loss attributable to common stockholders increased from $78.167 million to $85.660 million. Basic loss per share increased from $0.36 to $0.39.

required_facts.meaning: FY2018 common-stockholder net loss before restatement was USD 78.167 million.
The same FY2018 common-stockholder loss after restatement was USD 85.660 million.
FY2018 basic loss per share before restatement was USD 0.36.
FY2018 basic loss per share after restatement was USD 0.39.

acceptable_variants: Net loss rose/increased/worsened; earnings or signed net result became more negative.
USD 78,167 thousand to USD 85,660 thousand; USD 78,167,000 to USD 85,660,000.
Negative EPS of -$0.36 to -$0.39; loss-per-share magnitudes $0.36 to $0.39.
A correctly identified combined basic-and-diluted figure is acceptable because both measures are the same here.

numeric_sign_unit_tolerance.loss_values: Accept exact source units/conversions or correctly rounded amounts identified as approximate, down to one decimal place in millions (about $78.2m to $85.7m). Unqualified source-precision amounts should match the reported values.
numeric_sign_unit_tolerance.eps_values: Retain cent-level distinction: $0.36 versus $0.39. Equivalent trailing-zero formatting is acceptable.
numeric_sign_unit_tolerance.sign: Positive amounts with an explicit loss label, parentheses, or negative signed results are equivalent. Describing these figures as profits is incorrect.
numeric_sign_unit_tolerance.direction: Loss magnitudes increase; signed earnings decrease. Either clearly stated convention is valid.

scope_constraints: Net loss attributable to common stockholders, not net loss attributable to the company; the latter uses different figures.
Do not infer a new EPS by recomputation. The reported values themselves answer the question.

references.reference_answer: The company had not included all relevant costs when estimating service costs for extended maintenance contracts, so the required loss accrual was underestimated. The report identifies omitted historical costs associated with the cost-classification error, hydrogen-infrastructure service costs, and warrant provisions.

required_facts.meaning: The prior estimate failed to consider all relevant service/maintenance costs when determining the need for a contract loss accrual.
Including those costs required an additional loss accrual; the earlier accrual estimate was insufficient.

supporting_details_optional: Historical costs were incompletely considered because costs had been misclassified as research and development.
The source reports a FY2018 provision of about USD 5.3 million, but the question does not require the amount.
acceptable_variants: Omitted relevant costs led to an understated maintenance-contract loss provision.
The company underestimated the required contract-loss reserve because its service-cost estimate left out relevant costs.
Specific source-listed omissions that clearly convey the incomplete-cost estimate and additional-accrual consequence are sufficient; all three examples need not be enumerated.

numeric_sign_unit_tolerance.optional_amount: If an amount is voluntarily supplied, approximately $5.3 million or $5.345 million from the FY2018 statement is consistent. The FY2019 $1.6 million benefit is a different period and does not answer this question.

scope_constraints: FY2018 extended-maintenance-contract loss accrual, not the separate lease-liability accounting correction.
The answer must state the omitted-cost reason; a generic claim that accounting errors existed is insufficient.
Do not attribute the change to newly incurred FY2020 operating losses or invent a customer-default explanation.

evidence.location: Note 2, loss-accrual-provision paragraph continuing to the next page
evidence.bounded_paraphrase: The company connects the estimation problem to costs misclassified as research and development.

evidence.location: Opening continuation of the loss-accrual explanation
evidence.bounded_paraphrase: The estimate omitted relevant historical costs, infrastructure service costs and warrant provisions; including them required additional accruals, including a FY2018 provision.

FY2018, 2018 financial year, or year ended December 31, 2018.
